items.source: The default implementation returns an empty list.
items.translation: 默认实现返回一个空列表。

items.source: If this method returns false, the assignment (=), increment (++), and decrement (--) operators are disabled.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回 `false`，则禁用赋值（`=`）、递增（`++`）和递减（`--`）运算符。

items.source: In contrast to setVariable(String, Object), this method should only be invoked to support the assignment operator (=) within an expression.
items.translation: 与setVariable(String, Object)相反，此方法仅应在表达式中支持赋值运算符（=）时调用。

items.source: By default, this method delegates to setVariable(String, Object), providing the value created by the valueSupplier. Concrete implementations may override this default method to provide different semantics.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此方法委托给setVariable(String, Object)，提供由valueSupplier创建的值。具体实现可以覆盖此默认方法以提供不同的语义。

items.source: In contrast to assignVariable(String, Supplier), this method should only be invoked programmatically when interacting directly with the EvaluationContext — for example, to provide initial configuration for the context.
items.translation: 与assignVariable(String, Supplier)相反，此方法仅在直接与EvaluationContext交互时应通过编程方式调用——例如，为上下文提供初始配置。

items.source: By default, this method returns true. Concrete implementations may override this default method to disable assignment.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此方法返回true。具体实现可以覆盖此默认方法以禁用赋值。

items.source: There are two default implementations of this interface.
items.translation: 该接口有两个默认实现。

items.source: This can be overridden when evaluating an expression.
items.translation: 在评估表达式时，可以覆盖此行为。

items.source: Return a bean resolver that can look up beans by name.
items.translation: 返回一个可以通过名称查找 Bean 的 Bean 解析器。

items.source:
Return an operator overloader that may support mathematical operations
between more than the standard set of types.
items.translation: 返回一个运算符重载器，它可能支持标准类型集之外的多种类型之间的数学运算。

items.source: Return a type comparator for comparing pairs of objects for equality.
items.translation: 返回一个类型比较器，用于比较对象对是否相等。

items.source: Return a type converter that can convert (or coerce) a value from one type to another.
items.translation: 返回一个类型转换器，该转换器可以将值从一种类型转换（或强制）为另一种类型。

items.source:
Return a type locator that can be used to find types, either by short or
fully qualified name.
items.translation: 返回一个类型定位器，可用于通过简短名称或完全限定名称查找类型。

items.source: Look up a named variable within this evaluation context.
items.translation: 在此评估上下文中查找命名变量。

items.source: SimpleEvaluationContext: a simpler builder-style EvaluationContext variant for data-binding purposes, which allows for opting into several SpEL features as needed.
items.translation: SimpleEvaluationContext：一种用于数据绑定的更简单的构建器风格 EvaluationContext 变体，允许根据需要启用多种 SpEL 功能。

items.source: StandardEvaluationContext: a powerful and highly configurable EvaluationContext implementation, which can be extended, rather than having to implement everything manually.
items.translation: StandardEvaluationContext：一个功能强大且高度可配置的 EvaluationContext 实现，可以对其进行扩展，而无需手动实现所有内容。

items.source: a TypedValue wrapping the assigned value
items.translation: 一个包装了赋值值的TypedValue。

items.source: true if assignment is enabled; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示已启用赋值；否则为 false。

items.source: name - the name of the variable to assign
items.translation: name - 要赋值的变量名

items.source: valueSupplier - the supplier of the value to be assigned to the variable
items.translation: valueSupplier - 要分配给该变量的值的提供者

items.source: name - the name of the variable to set
items.translation: name - 要设置的变量名

items.source: value - the value to be placed in the variable
items.translation: value - 要放置在变量中的值

items.source: name - the name of the variable to look up
items.translation: name - 要查找的变量名

items.source: the value of the variable, or null if not found
items.translation: 变量的值，或如果未找到则为null

items.source: Assign the value created by the specified Supplier to a named variable within this evaluation context.
items.translation: 将指定Supplier创建的值分配到此评估上下文中的命名变量。

items.source: Return a list of resolvers that will be asked in turn to locate a constructor.
items.translation: 返回一个解析器列表，这些解析器将按顺序被请求以定位构造函数。

items.source:
Return a list of index accessors that will be asked in turn to access or
set an indexed value.
items.translation: 返回一个索引访问器列表，这些访问器将按顺序被请求以访问或设置索引值。

items.source: Return a list of resolvers that will be asked in turn to locate a method.
items.translation: 返回一个解析器列表，这些解析器将按顺序被请求以定位方法。

items.source: Return a list of accessors that will be asked in turn to read/write a property.
items.translation: 返回一个访问器列表，这些访问器将按顺序被请求以读取/写入属性。

items.source:
Return the default root context object against which unqualified
properties, methods, etc.
items.translation: 返回默认根上下文对象，用于对未限定的属性、方法等进行解析。

items.source:
Determine if assignment is enabled within expressions evaluated by this evaluation
context.
items.translation: 确定是否在此评估上下文中启用了表达式赋值。

items.source: Set a named variable in this evaluation context to a specified value.
items.translation: 在此评估上下文中将命名变量设置为指定值。

items.source: Andy Clement, Juergen Hoeller, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Andy Clement，Juergen Hoeller，Sam Brannen
